name: Field Trip Proposal for Approval
description: Field trip proposals are presented to the principal and, if approved, forwarded to the Assistant Superintendent; includes the adult-supervision plan.
preparedBy: District staff member proposing the trip
recipient: Building principal, then Assistant Superintendent or designee
deadline: at least 1 month in advance of the trip
quote: All field trip proposals of District staff members shall be presented to their building principal at least one (1) month in advance of the proposed trip for approval. If approved by the building principal, the proposal shall be forwarded to the Assistant Superintendent or designee for approval.
